## 本次更新
本版改善 Windows App 远程连接中的粘贴兼容性，并修复文本预览滚动时可能卡死的问题。
- **Windows App 远程粘贴**：修复通过双击历史记录或快捷键粘贴到远程 Windows 时，可能只输入字母 `v` 的问题。针对 Windows App 使用完整的 `Ctrl+V` 按键序列，并等待触发快捷键的修饰键松开、目标应用恢复焦点后再发送。 - **更稳妥的自动粘贴**：统一普通粘贴、纯文本粘贴和 AI 结果粘贴的按键发送逻辑；取消粘贴时释放模拟按键，避免按键残留。 - **文本预览不再卡死**：修复文本预览在滚动临界位置可能陷入布局循环、导致界面无响应的问题。（#66）
## What's New
This release improves pasting into Windows App remote sessions and fixes a text preview freeze during scrolling.
- **Remote paste in Windows App**: Fixes an issue where double-clicking a history item or using a quick-paste shortcut could type only `v` on the remote Windows PC. Clipaste now sends a complete `Ctrl+V` sequence for Windows App, waiting for shortcut modifiers to be released and the target app to regain focus. - **More robust automatic paste**: Regular paste, plain-text paste, and AI-result paste now share the same keystroke handling. Cancelled sequences release their simulated keys to avoid leaving modifiers held. - **Text preview freeze fix**: Fixes a layout loop that could make text previews unresponsive near the scrolling boundary. (#66)

## 本次更新
本版修复连续快速复制后呼出面板卡顿、中间记录丢失的问题，并重新设计了设置页侧边栏。
- **连续复制不再丢记录**：快速连续复制多段内容时，中间的复制可能来不及被记录，只剩最后一条。现在每一次复制都会被完整记录，并按复制顺序排列。（#65） - **呼出面板不再卡顿**：连续复制后立即用快捷键或菜单栏图标呼出面板，之前可能要卡好几秒才有反应，现在会立即打开。 - **更省资源**：每次复制触发的数据库查询更少，连续复制时后台占用明显降低。 - **全新设置侧边栏**：设置页侧边栏改用系统原生样式，每个设置项配上彩色图标，选中项使用强调色高亮；图标大小跟随系统侧边栏尺寸设置，「关于」的更新提示红点显示在图标上。
## What's New
This release fixes lag and lost history after rapid copying, and redesigns the settings sidebar.
- **No more lost copies**: When copying several items in quick succession, items in the middle could be skipped, leaving only the last one. Every copy is now recorded, in the order you copied it. (#65) - **Panel opens instantly**: Opening the panel with the shortcut or the menu bar icon right after a burst of copies could hang for several seconds. It now opens right away. - **Lighter on resources**: Each copy triggers fewer database queries, so bursts of copying use noticeably less background work. - **Redesigned settings sidebar**: The settings sidebar now uses the native macOS style, with a colored icon for each section and accent-colored selection. Icons follow the system sidebar size setting, and the update badge for "About" now sits on its icon.

## 本次更新
本版修复卡片顶部颜色取得不准、同一个 App 颜色不统一的问题，并补齐各语言的翻译。
- **卡片颜色更准确**：改进从 App 图标取色的方式，优先取图标的品牌色，不再被深色背景或阴影带偏。例如 Obsidian、Raycast、密码等 App 之前显示为黑色，现在会显示各自的品牌色；Chrome 也不会再在黄、红、绿之间随机变化。 - **同一个 App 颜色统一**：同一个 App 的所有卡片现在使用同一种颜色，旧记录也会自动生效，无需重新复制。 - **多语言补全**：补齐置顶、剪贴板变化提示音、记录其他设备内容、首次引导、分组图标选择等文案的德语、法语、日语、韩语翻译，部分缺失的中文翻译也已补上；iCloud 同步错误提示也会按系统语言显示。
## What's New
This release makes card header colors accurate and consistent, and completes translations across all languages.
- **More accurate card colors**: Colors picked from app icons now favor the icon's brand color instead of dark backgrounds or shadows. Apps such as Obsidian, Raycast and Passwords previously showed black headers and now show their brand colors, and Chrome no longer switches between yellow, red and green. - **Consistent colors per app**: All cards from the same app now share one color, including existing history items — no need to copy them again. - **Complete translations**: Adds German, French, Japanese and Korean translations for pinning, the clipboard change sound, content from other devices, onboarding and the group icon picker, plus a few missing Chinese strings. iCloud sync error messages now follow the system language.
